category_edits.rationale: Scale history embeddings by a fixed inverse-frequency feature computed solely from each category's training interactions. This may reduce frequent items' dominance while preserving learned embeddings, GRU topology, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. The persistent buffer is restored by the existing generated predictor, which imports the same model class.
